room_description: A vibrant, futuristic robot or toy factory room filled with various robotic figures, colorful building blocks, digital monitors, and metal paneling.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the colorful robot room.
Finds a green number '7' printed on the back of a black monitor.
Inspects a 3x3 circular grid on a white wall panel.
Finds a purple number '5' on the chest of a grey plush robot.
Presses 'play' on the central white monitor to start a sequence.
Watches the three TV-head robots perform a randomized color sequence.
Inputs the memorized color sequence into the 3x3 wall grid.
Collects a metal crowbar from the opened wall panel.
Uses the crowbar to pry off a metal plate on the wall, revealing a keypad.
Enters the numerical code '953' into the robot keypad.

solution_steps: Press play on the monitor and observe the sequence of face emojis.
Change the faces on the row of red robots to match the monitor's sequence.
Watch the three TV-head robots flash different colors.
Go to the 3x3 wall panel and input the corresponding colors in the correct order.
Pry off the metal plate using the crowbar.
Find the hidden numbers associated with three specific robots around the room (White/Grey = 9, Blue = 5, Red = 3).
Enter the code '953' into the keypad.

final_action: Entering the final correct code into the wall keypad automatically unlocks the main door, allowing escape.
